descriptionInUI: Requires Motor Pool. Convoys and reserve armor groups advance by a configurable distance per turn and resume from their saved position. Move reserve groups to friendly GPS positions, bases or fronts, or deploy new groups from base stock. Transport requirements and tractor shortages apply. The OPFOR API supports the same reserve movements. Disabling the plugin pauses existing journeys without removing units. SAM-site movement is not available yet. Off by default.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Road travel budget per turn, in statute miles. Default 120 miles (193.1 km). Long journeys continue over several turns. Road and off-road portions share one turn's budget.
Cross-country travel budget per turn, in statute miles. Default 60 miles (96.6 km), half the road budget. Includes access to and from roads.
